selected_evidence.requirement: Cluster stood up with 3 members holding application data
selected_evidence.summary: Cluster bootstrapped on node1, node2 and node3 joined sequentially reaching wsrep_cluster_size=3/Synced; appdb.orders table created on node1 and confirmed replicated to node2 and node3.

selected_evidence.requirement: Healthy baseline captured before maintenance shutdown
selected_evidence.summary: Pre-maintenance checkpoint write inserted on node2 and baseline boot_id + wsrep cluster size/state + row count (4 rows) captured on all three nodes.

selected_evidence.requirement: Cluster brought down completely for maintenance window
selected_evidence.summary: mariadb stopped on node3, node2, then node1; grastate.dat on all three nodes confirms inactive service and recorded seqnos (node1 highest at 9, safe_to_bootstrap=1).

selected_evidence.requirement: Cluster brought back with every committed write still present and all three members serving
selected_evidence.summary: node1 re-bootstrapped via galera_new_cluster with all 4 prior rows intact; node2 and node3 rejoined (cluster size 2 then 3, both Synced) with identical data; a post-maintenance write from node3 replicated to node1 and node2, proving all three members are serving writes again.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: node1 boot identity change and recovery
selected_evidence.summary: node1 baseline boot_id 8c28f3cd...; systemctl reboot acknowledged; node became unreachable then reachable again with new boot_id 70c46d29...; mariadb active with wsrep_cluster_size=3/Synced and all 5 rows present post-reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: node2 boot identity change and recovery
selected_evidence.summary: node2 baseline boot_id e65e6bcf...; reboot acknowledged; node unreachable then back with new boot_id 74f929f6...; after brief SST activation, mariadb reached active/Synced with wsrep_cluster_size=3 and all 5 rows present.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: node3 boot identity change and recovery, full cluster health after final node
selected_evidence.summary: node3 baseline boot_id 54089086...; reboot acknowledged; node unreachable then back with new boot_id ce08fd3d...; mariadb active/Synced with wsrep_cluster_size=3 and all 5 rows present; final cross-check on node1 and node2 confirms cluster_size=3, Synced, and matching row count (5) on all three nodes after all restarts.
